Name: Spiked Barricade
Description: Sturdy timber palisade that obstructs enemy movement and deals contact thorn damage.

Name: Radiant Beacon
Description: Erects a sustained brazier that establishes a localized safe haven of daylight.

Name: Ash Siphon
Description: Mechanical extractor that filters surrounding soil to harvest residual ash embers over time.

Name: Kinetic Springboard
Description: Tension-loaded wooden trap that catapults intruding enemies backward upon triggering.
